lines.beaver: 지수 씨, 벌써 열한 시예요. 집에 어떻게 가요?
lines.beaver_en: Jisu, it's already eleven. How are you getting home?
lines.beaver_roman: Jisu ssi, beolsseo yeolhan siyeyo. Jibe eotteoke gayo?
lines.learner: 막차가 걱정돼요. 회의하느라고 시간을 못 봤어요.
lines.en: I'm worried about the last train. I was in a meeting and didn't check the time.
lines.roman: Makchaga geokjeongdwaeyo. Hoeuihaneurago siganeul mot bwasseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: What time is the last subway?
lines.learner: 수원행 막차가 열한 시 사십 분이에요.
lines.en: The last train to Suwon is at 11:40.
lines.roman: Suwonhaeng makchaga yeolhan si sasip buniyeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Do you have to transfer at a transfer station?
lines.en: Yes, the route map shows Sadang is the transfer station.

lines.beaver_en: How about the city bus? The stop is close.
lines.en: I get motion sickness on buses, so it's hard.

lines.beaver: 제 차가 근처에 있어요. 사당역까지 태워 줄까요?
lines.beaver_en: My car is nearby. Shall I give you a ride to Sadang Station?
lines.beaver_roman: Je chaga geuncheoe isseoyo. Sadangyeokkkaji taewo julkkayo?
lines.en: Great! The team leader also told us to head home early.

lines.beaver: 차가 좀 지저분해요. 세차를 못 했어요.
lines.beaver_en: The car is a bit messy. I didn't get a car wash.
lines.beaver_roman: Chaga jom jijeobunhaeyo. Sechareul mo taesseoyo.
lines.en: It's fine. I'm just grateful you're giving me a ride.

lines.beaver_en: Where do we get the parking ticket?
lines.en: We can get the parking ticket at the restaurant counter.

lines.beaver_en: My car is a bit old, so it's slow.
lines.learner: 괜찮아요. 길이 안 막히면 금방 가요.
lines.en: It's okay. If the roads aren't jammed, we'll get there quickly.
lines.roman: Gwaenchanayo. Giri an makimyeon geumbang gayo.

lines.beaver_en: I'll drop you off right when we reach the station.
lines.en: As soon as I get out, I'll run and buy a ticket.

lines.beaver_en: There'll be lots of passengers. Get home safe.
lines.en: Thanks. I'll text you as soon as I get home.
